abilities.name: E—Excuse Me, Please!
abilities.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to 1% of Misha's ATK to a single target enemy.

abilities.name: R—Room Service
abilities.text: Increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by 1 hit(s). Deals Ice DMG equal to 2% of Misha's ATK to a single target enemy, and Ice DMG equal to 0.8% of Misha's ATK to adjacent targets.

abilities.name: G—Gonna Be Late!
abilities.text:
Has 3 Hits Per Action by default. First, uses 1 hit to deal Ice DMG equal to 0.6% of Misha's ATK to a single target enemy. Then, the rest of the hits each deals Ice DMG equal to 0.6% of Misha's ATK to a single random enemy. Just before each hit lands, there is a 0.2% base chance to Freeze the target, lasting for 1 turn.
While Frozen, enemy targets cannot take any actions, and at the start of their turn, they receive Additional Ice DMG equal to 0.3% of Misha's ATK.
This Ultimate can possess up to 10 Hits Per Action. After the Ultimate is used, its Hits Per Action will be reset to the default level.

abilities.name: Horological Escapement
abilities.text: Whenever any ally consumes 1 Skill Point, Misha's next Ultimate delivers 1 more Hit(s) Per Action and Misha regenerates 2 Energy.

abilities.name: Wait, You Are So Beautiful!
abilities.text: After using the Technique, creates a dimension that lasts for 15 seconds. Enemies caught in the dimension are inflicted with Dream Prison and stop all their actions. Upon entering battle against enemies afflicted with Dream Prison, increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by 2 hit(s). Only 1 dimension created by allies can exist at the same time.

abilities.name: Release
abilities.desc: Before the Ultimate's first hit lands, increases the base chance of Freezing the target by 80%.

abilities.name: Interlock
abilities.desc: When using the Ultimate, increases the Effect Hit Rate by 60%, lasting until the end of the Ultimate's current action.

abilities.name: Transmission
abilities.desc: When dealing DMG to Frozen enemies, increases CRIT DMG by 30%.

abilities.name: Whimsicality of Fancy
abilities.desc: When using the Ultimate, for every enemy on the field, additionally increases the Hits Per Action for the Ultimate by 1 hit(s), up to a maximum increase of 5 hit(s).

abilities.name: Yearning of Youth
abilities.desc: Before each hit of the Ultimate lands, there is a 24% base chance of reducing the target's DEF by 16% for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Vestige of Happiness
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Visage of Kinship
abilities.desc: Increases the DMG multiplier for each hit of the Ultimate by 6%.

abilities.name: Genesis of First Love
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Estrangement of Dream
abilities.desc: When using the Ultimate, increases own DMG by 30%, lasting until the end of the turn. In addition, the next time the Skill is used, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.
